title: feat(ai-chat): highlight matched term in conversation-list search
body:
## What

Searching the AI conversation list already filters rows, but gave **no hint which word matched**. This wraps each case-insensitive occurrence of the query in a styled `<mark>` across the row **title and preview**, so search results are scannable — matching ChatGPT/Claude.

## Notes

- **Purely additive**: with no active query the text renders untouched, so the common (non-searching) path pays nothing.
- Conservative styling via existing design tokens (`bg-primary/20`), original casing preserved.
- Threaded the active `filter` query into `ConversationRow` via a new optional `query` prop; new module-level `highlightQuery(text, query)` helper.

## Test

`ConversationsSidebar.test.tsx`: typing a query filters out non-matching rows and renders the matched substring inside a `<mark>`. Full sidebar suite green (6).

Part of the AI chat UX polish pass (the conversation-list "③" track). Structural list features (date groups, collapsible sidebar, keyboard shortcuts, resizable split) are already merged; this is a focused readability win on top.
